liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Beat It On Down The Line** (1 review): Beat It On Down The Line is the standard against which others are measured [13]
- **China Cat Sunflower** (1 review): China Cat Sunflower is called the coolest and hottest version ever [12]
- **Truckin'** (1 review): Truckin' into Mind Left Body Jam may be a favorite, takeoff around 9:30 [11]

## The recordings

- **gd74-05-19.sbd.clugston.6957.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 33 songs; 193 min; rated 4.45/5 by 114 [1]. Said about its sound: Jerry's vocals are really low on Jack Straw through Roses; First disk audio problems noted despite the show being rated great; Weather Report Suite mix is spacious and clear; previously uncirculating tunes have insignificant mix issues [10][16][17]
- **gd1974-05-19.sbd.clugston.thir13en.remaster-6957.79781.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 33 songs; 193 min; rated 4.4/5 by 5 [2]. Said about its sound: Source showed age; remastered with spectrum tweaks, light compression, warmth, and maximization [2]
- **gd1974-05-19.115876.aud-patlee.cousinit.flac16**: audience recording; 34 songs; 192 min; rated 4.67/5 by 6 [3]
- **gd1974-05-19.sbd.aj.203.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 24 songs; 166 min; rated 5/5 by 5 [8]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd74-05-19.sbd.clugston.6957.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [1]. Also: Master Soundboard Reel transferred to PCM, DAT, CDR, then EAC'ed and SHN'ed by Scott Clugston [1]
- **gd1974-05-19.sbd.clugston.thir13en.remaster-6957.79781.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by thir13en Productions; source: Remastered version of shn id 6957 [2]
- **gd1974-05-19.115876.aud-patlee.cousinit.flac16**: taped by Pat Lee; transferred by CousinIt; source: Source: Sony ECM18N mics>Sony 152SD deck; Recorded by Pat Lee; [3]. Also: Beautiful recording by Pat Lee, a few generations down [3]
- **gd1974-05-19.sbd.aj.203.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by AJ; source: Soundboard [8]. Also: Complete show on SBD except Tennessee Jed through El Paso and Ship Of Fools [8]

## Art and photos

- Poster by rockblog.bluesspot: [Grateful Dead – Portland Memorial Coliseum 1974 (remastered) & Pacific Northwest ’73-’74](https://rockblogbluesspot.com/2018/10/04/grateful-dead-portland-memorial-coliseum-1974-remastered-pacific-northwest-73-74/) [22]
- Fan art by LUV4MUSIC!: [Spotlight On What I Am Listening To: Grateful Dead - Portland Memorial Coliseum, Portland, OR 1974-05-19 MATRIX - LUV4MU](https://www.luv4music.org/2026/05/18/spotlight-on-what-i-am-listening-to-grateful-dead-portland-memorial-coliseum-portland-or-1974-05-19-matrix/) [23]
